name: unity-libraries
description: Third-party Unity 6 libraries (17 skills): async and reactive (UniTask, R3, ObservableCollections), DI and messaging (VContainer, MessagePipe, ZBase PubSub), serialization and data (MessagePack-CSharp, MemoryPack, MasterMemory, ZBase CSV Reader with Google Sheets download), networking (MagicOnion), memory and strings (NativeMemoryArray, ZString, ZBase Pooling), logging (ZLogger), and UI/animation (UIEffect v5, Animation Sequencer DOTween timelines).
